import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json','r') as f:
    data=json.load(f)

# Aggregate globally to emphasize crossover dynamics and closure acceleration
pay=pd.DataFrame(data['digital_payment_penetration']['data'])
branches=pd.DataFrame(data['traditional_bank_branches']['data'])
licenses=pd.DataFrame(data['digital_bank_licenses']['data'])

# Global yearly series
pay_g=pay.groupby('year',as_index=False)['penetration_pct'].mean()
branches_g=branches.groupby('year',as_index=False)['branches_k'].sum()
licenses_g=licenses.groupby('year',as_index=False)['cumulative_licenses'].sum()

# Normalize each metric to 2015=100 for comparable trajectory/crossover storytelling
base_pay=pay_g.loc[pay_g.year==2015,'penetration_pct'].iloc[0]
base_br=branches_g.loc[branches_g.year==2015,'branches_k'].iloc[0]
base_li=licenses_g.loc[licenses_g.year==2015,'cumulative_licenses'].iloc[0]

plot_df=pd.DataFrame({
    'year':pay_g['year'],
    'Digital payment penetration index (2015=100)':pay_g['penetration_pct']/base_pay*100,
    'Digital bank licenses index (2015=100)':licenses_g['cumulative_licenses']/base_li*100,
    'Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)':branches_g['branches_k']/base_br*100,
})

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14,8),dpi=160)

colors={
    'Digital payment penetration index (2015=100)':'#1f77b4',
    'Digital bank licenses index (2015=100)':'#17a2b8',
    'Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)':'#c0392b'
}

for col in [
    'Digital payment penetration index (2015=100)',
    'Digital bank licenses index (2015=100)',
    'Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)'
]:
    ax.plot(plot_df['year'],plot_df[col],label=col,color=colors[col],linewidth=3)

# Highlight 2020 acceleration window
ax.axvspan(2019.5,2020.5,color='#7f8c8d',alpha=0.15)
ax.text(2020, ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.94, 'Closure acceleration\n(2019→2020)', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10, color='#2c3e50')

# Annotate branch decline rate from 2019 to 2020
b2019=float(plot_df.loc[plot_df.year==2019,'Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)'])
b2020=float(plot_df.loc[plot_df.year==2020,'Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)'])
ax.annotate(f'{(b2020-b2019):.1f} pts',xy=(2020,b2020),xytext=(2021.0,b2020-8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color=colors['Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)'],lw=1.8),
            color=colors['Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)'],fontsize=10)

ax.set_title('Fintech Disruption Crossover: Digital Adoption Surges as Physical Branch Networks Contract (2015–2024)',
             fontsize=16, weight='bold', pad=14)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Index (2015 = 100)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xticks(plot_df['year'])
ax.set_xlim(2015,2024)

# Executive-friendly legend
leg=ax.legend(title='Global Composite Trends',loc='upper left',frameon=True,facecolor='white')
leg.get_title().set_fontsize(11)
for t in leg.get_texts():
    t.set_fontsize(10)

# Source note and units traceability
fig.text(0.01,0.01,
         'Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json | Digital payment penetration: % of adults (regional mean); '\
         'Branches: thousand branches (regional sum); Licenses: cumulative count (regional sum).',
         fontsize=9,color='#4d4d4d')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0.04,1,1])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png',bbox_inches='tight')
PY

import json
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json','r') as f:
    data=json.load(f)

def group_mean(records, val_key):
    sums=defaultdict(float)
    counts=defaultdict(int)
    for r in records:
        y=r['year']
        sums[y]+=float(r[val_key])
        counts[y]+=1
    years=sorted(sums)
    vals=[sums[y]/counts[y] for y in years]
    return years, vals

def group_sum(records, val_key):
    sums=defaultdict(float)
    for r in records:
        sums[r['year']]+=float(r[val_key])
    years=sorted(sums)
    vals=[sums[y] for y in years]
    return years, vals

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import json, math
from collections import defaultdict

W,H = 1600,1000
m = dict(left=120,right=40,top=100,bottom=140)
plot_w = W-m['left']-m['right']
plot_h = H-m['top']-m['bottom']

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json','r') as f:
    data=json.load(f)

def group_mean(records, key):
    s=defaultdict(float); c=defaultdict(int)
    for r in records:
        y=r['year']; s[y]+=float(r[key]); c[y]+=1
    yrs=sorted(s)
    return yrs,[s[y]/c[y] for y in yrs]

def group_sum(records, key):
    s=defaultdict(float)
    for r in records:
        s[r['year']]+=float(r[key])
    yrs=sorted(s)
    return yrs,[s[y] for y in yrs]

years,pay=group_mean(data['digital_payment_penetration']['data'],'penetration_pct')
_,branches=group_sum(data['traditional_bank_branches']['data'],'branches_k')
_,licenses=group_sum(data['digital_bank_licenses']['data'],'cumulative_licenses')

pay_idx=[v/pay[0]*100 for v in pay]
br_idx=[v/branches[0]*100 for v in branches]
li_idx=[v/licenses[0]*100 for v in licenses]

series=[('Digital payment penetration index (2015=100)',pay_idx,'#1f77b4'),('Digital bank licenses index (2015=100)',li_idx,'#17a2b8'),('Traditional bank branches index (2015=100)',br_idx,'#c0392b')]

ymin=70
ymax=max(max(pay_idx),max(br_idx),max(li_idx))
ymax=math.ceil(ymax/50)*50

img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)

try:
    f_title=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',40)
    f_axis=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',24)
    f_tick=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',20)
    f_legend=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',20)
    f_note=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',16)
except:
    f_title=f_axis=f_tick=f_legend=f_note=ImageFont.load_default()

# title
d.text((m['left'],30),'Fintech Disruption Crossover: Digital Adoption Surges as Physical Branch Networks Contract (2015–2024)',fill='#111',font=f_title)

# axes
d.line([(m['left'],m['top']), (m['left'],H-m['bottom'])], fill='#333', width=3)
d.line([(m['left'],H-m['bottom']), (W-m['right'],H-m['bottom'])], fill='#333', width=3)

# y grid/ticks
for yv in range(100, ymax+1, 100):
    py = m['top'] + (ymax-yv)/(ymax-ymin)*plot_h
    d.line([(m['left'],py),(W-m['right'],py)], fill='#e6e6e6', width=1)
    d.text((40,py-10),str(yv),fill='#444',font=f_tick)

# x ticks
for i,yr in enumerate(years):
    px = m['left'] + i/(len(years)-1)*plot_w
    d.line([(px,H-m['bottom']),(px,H-m['bottom']+8)], fill='#333', width=2)
    d.text((px-20,H-m['bottom']+16),str(yr),fill='#444',font=f_tick)

# highlight 2020 band
i19=years.index(2019); i20=years.index(2020)
x19 = m['left'] + i19/(len(years)-1)*plot_w
x20 = m['left'] + i20/(len(years)-1)*plot_w
d.rectangle([x19+(x20-x19)/2,m['top'],x20+(x20-x19)/2,H-m['bottom']], fill='#dfe6e9')
